narr: Scattered thunderstorms moved northwest across southeast Arizona during the afternoon and evening. Storms caused wind damage to trees and produced flash flooding across northern parts of the Tucson Metro area.
ev: Around 1 of heavy rain in less an 1 hour caused Valley View Wash to flood N. Flecha Dr. as well as River Rd. between Swan and Pontatoc Rds. in the Catalina Foothils.
lsr: RIVER ROAD FROM PONTATOC ROAD TO SWAN ROAD WAS CLOSED DUE TO FLOODING.
THE INTERSECTION OF NORTH FLECHA DRIVE AND EAST CALLE BARRIL TO NORTH CAIDA PLACE WAS CLOSED DUE TO FLOODING.
